evidence.reason: The guard is still bypassable at the pinned tip: `visit` checks `estimate > REPORT_CAP` only when entering a node (line 951), then a large string or object-key increment is added afterward (lines 952 and 959) with no recheck. A report that is one large string, or ends with one, therefore reaches `JSON.stringify` at line 966 without triggering the bound, and the size is rejected only after the full serialized body has been allocated (line 967). This is an implementation bug in the existing anti-allocation guard, not a proposal to add a new requirement.
